vertical_reference: EGM96 orthometric heights in metres as specified by Tilezen Skadi documentation
solver_treatment: flat z=0 m model-relative ground is an explicit assumption; DEM retained for later use
critical_caveats: DEM values are not local surveyed bare-earth DTM, LiDAR, roof elevations or usable building heights.
Buildings/vegetation/radar and merging artifacts can affect elevation samples.
About 30 m source sampling cannot resolve curb or sidewalk elevations.
No resampling or terrain-to-roof subtraction was performed.
Actual source acquisition date is older than current buildings/weather and is not the download date.
warning_notes: Coarse ~30m resolution radar composite DEM; does not resolve street curb elevations, pavement grades, or building bases. Appropriate solely for regional elevation contextualization, not microclimate terrain relief.
